name: pipedrive-mcp
description: Pipedrive CRM as MCP tools: find deals, people and companies, and move deals through a pipeline.
long_description:
Pipedrive CRM over MCP: find deals, people, organizations and activities, write to them, and move deals through a pipeline. Custom fields are resolved by name rather than by the hashed keys the API uses, so a filter reads the way the CRM does.

THIS BUNDLE NEEDS YOUR OWN API TOKEN. Pipedrive issues one per user under Personal preferences → API; paste it below along with your company domain. The token is stored by Claude Desktop as a sensitive value and is never written to this server's logs.

api_token.title: API token
api_token.description: Your Pipedrive API token, from Personal preferences → API. Stored as a sensitive value.

company_domain.title: Company domain
company_domain.description: The subdomain your Pipedrive lives on, as in <company>.pipedrive.com.

dry_run.title: Dry run
dry_run.description: Report what a write would do without sending it.
